title.en: Chapter 8 — The Meat and the Eagles

book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: الصبح، وقعت قطعة لحمة كبيرة جنبي.
sentences.en: In the morning, a big piece of meat fell beside me.
I remembered a story I had heard from merchants.

sentences.ar: التجار بيرموا لحمة، والألماس بيلزق فيها.
sentences.en: The merchants throw meat, and the diamonds stick to it.

sentences.ar: حطيت ألماس بجيبي وربطت حالي باللحمة.
sentences.en: I put diamonds in my pocket and tied myself to the meat.
A big eagle came and carried it up.
The merchants shouted at the eagle so it left the meat.
When they saw me, they were afraid and then they laughed.

sentences.ar: أعطيتهم شوية ألماس ورجعنا مع بعض.
sentences.en: I gave them some diamonds and we went back together.
